title: Relationship
description: A single typed, directed edge from the owning object to another canonical object. The (verb, source_type, target_type) triple must be permitted by the ontology in /relationships/ontology.json — see /docs/relationship-model.md.

type.description: The semantic verb describing this edge. Arbitrary/untyped links are not permitted.

target_id.description: The globally unique id of the target object this edge points to. Must resolve to an object that exists in the dataset.

target_type.description: The declared entity type of the target, used to validate the edge against the ontology and to catch stale/incorrect references.

reason.description: Why this edge exists, in plain language. Mandatory: an edge without a stated reason is not permitted, since the verb+target alone rarely explains the judgement call behind it (e.g. why this control specifically, not another).

confidence.description: How much this specific edge should be trusted, using the same vocabulary as node-level confidence (/docs/confidence-model.md). Optional: an edge with no stated confidence is read as inheriting the source object's own confidence.

citation_ids.description: IDs of citations (declared in this object's own citations array) that specifically support this edge.
